reply.summary: Titelse is a soft-spoken contract gunner who takes jobs through back-alley brokers and never stays in one town for long. Patient and precise, this shooter prefers a single clean shot to a loud scene.

feats.scene: Titelse fires one round through a rain-streaked window and drops a courier's phone at two hundred paces.
Titelse tumbles down a flight of service stairs and rises with only bruises.

reply.summary: Illtonm is a rooftop marksman hired by dockside racketeers to draw a masked vigilante out of hiding. Wrist-mounted autoguns give this hired shot a second chance at range, but close quarters are a weakness.

feats.scene: Illtonm empties both wrist guns in a three-second burst that shreds the roof of a moving freight car.
Illtonm is slammed against a tunnel wall by a lunging opponent and keeps his grip on the trigger.
Illtonm rides the speeding carriage at full tilt while swivelling to track a pursuer.

reply.summary: Neltiu is a wry mercenary who keeps one photograph of his daughter taped inside his glove. A decent brawler, this gunman can hold his own against heavier fighters but rarely wins by fists alone.

feats.scene: Neltiu pins a gate lock with a single wrist-gun shot and kicks the door off its hinges.
Neltiu absorbs a heavy bruiser's roundhouse and stays standing long enough to retreat.

reply.summary: Rniva is a sardonic sharpshooter whose guilt over a childhood accident turned into obsessive accuracy. Cold on the job and tender at home, this marksman hates the word love yet cannot stop calling a particular child.

feats.scene: Rniva shatters a distant antenna mast with a single high-calibre round from a hilltop.
Rniva walks off a crash against a prison wall after being flung from a transport van.

reply.summary: Tessaniu is a mercenary who swore never to miss again after one terrible shot years ago. Quick to take a contract and quicker to finish it, this gunman works for whoever points him at a target.

feats.scene: Tessaniu clips a falling coin from the air with a pistol round during a bar bet.
Tessaniu is thrown through a thin partition and shrugs off the splinters.

reply.summary: Asranirn is an escape artist and demolitions-minded hired gun who has wounded even tough, nearly untouchable foes. Driving a bike through drainage tunnels and wiring charges that collapse whole roads, this killer for hire is a nuisance far above his station.

feats.scene: Asranirn detonates a string of charges that buckles a stretch of roadway and swallows three parked cars.
Asranirn crashes a stolen van through a barricade and walks away from the wreck.
Asranirn guns a motorbike down a flooded tunnel with pursuers close behind.

reply.summary: Teseoser is a masked gunman and professional troublemaker who joins squads of misfit criminals for pay. Dry humour hides a calculating mind, and this shooter is rarely seen out of costume.

feats.scene: Teseoser picks off three lamp bulbs in a row to plunge a warehouse into darkness.
Teseoser falls from a loading ramp onto concrete and gets up laughing.

reply.summary: Eomia is a veteran contract killer who walked away from the trade after becoming a father, then returned to hunt down a copycat. Weathered, wary and quietly proud, this old hand carries regret like a second weapon.

feats.scene: Eomia drops a masked impersonator from a quarter-mile away with one rifle shot.
Eomia takes a rifle butt to the ribs and still completes the shot.

reply.summary: Rnicelli is a convict turned mirror-obsessed crook who escaped prison with a broken glass sliver. Convinced that reflections hold every secret, this schemer builds crime sprees and contraptions around silvered glass.

feats.scene: Rnicelli aims a lattice of angled mirrors to scorch a vault door with focused sunlight.
Rnicelli is tackled by guards and keeps running with a cracked rib.

reply.summary: Torto is a pale invader from a red desert world who poses as a friendly visitor while preparing a conquest. Vulnerable to flame yet proud of crushing strength, this impostor greened a barren waste to win the public's trust.

feats.scene: Torto reshapes a thousand square kilometres of dune into farmland in a single night using borrowed alien machinery.
Torto is punched across the ocean surface and skips like a stone before getting up.

reply.summary: Leoorenu is a petty thief who dresses in a bug costume to rob storerooms. Overconfident and clumsy, this burglar won his first brawl and lost the rematch to a sticky net.

feats.scene: Leoorenu swings a crowbar into a supply cage and pops the lock in one blow.
Leoorenu is bound head to toe in tough cord and cannot snap even one strand.

reply.summary: Viliures is a gang boss who led armed robbers across farm country with weapons far ahead of their era. Smooth talking and ruthless, this crime lord thrived until a swift hero caught the whole gang.

feats.scene: Viliures orders a volley from automatic weapons that chews through a bank's wooden counter.
Viliures is bowled over by a blur of motion and lands hard on a train platform.

reply.summary: Tumco is a masked adventurer who hides a real identity behind a mantle of stone arches and buttresses. Designed by a fan with a love of odd heroes, this protector shields the weak by wedging stone supports between danger and bystanders.

feats.scene: Tumco throws a heavy stone arch across an alley to topple a runaway cart.
Tumco braces beneath a collapsing awning and holds the beam until crowds escape.

reply.summary: Orint is a brave flyer who led a ragged crew of soldiers on a rescue across an island full of ancient beasts. Loyal to his brothers in arms, this pilot understood that a family can be the people who fight beside you.

feats.scene: Orint dives a damaged plane into a clearing and rams a charging lizard-giant off its feet.
Orint climbs from a burning cockpit after a rough crash landing in jungle trees.
Orint banks a fighter plane through a canyon with a beast hunting behind him.

reply.summary: Amirn is a mystic warrior whose grandfather restored him after a brutal loss, teaching him herbs and illusions. Wearing a cape that lets him soar and vanish from view, this young shaman fights for his lost people far from home.

feats.scene: Amirn flings a bundle of enchanted herbs that bursts into a stinging cloud around armed intruders.
Amirn is struck by a thrown beam and recovers after chanting a short rite.

reply.summary: Osanus is a washed-up costumed hand for hire who clung to a thankless job for a decade. Mediocre in battle and devoted to routine, this veteran lost everything when the agency's office burned.

feats.scene: Osanus swings a sack of tools at a thug and knocks him sprawling.
Osanus staggers out of a smoke-filled stairwell with singed boots.

reply.summary: Arsorron is a heroic figure of old whose deeds were honoured in a painted portrait on a hall wall. Known more as legend than as person, this vigilante of the wild frontier inspires later guardians.

feats.scene: Arsorron shatters a sealed granary door with one strike of a carved club.
Arsorron endures a stampede of oxen without losing his footing.

reply.summary: Tastitis is a warrior who called on a forest spirit from the bottom of a trap and received a charm cut from fallen rock. Masked and mighty, this champion won leadership of his nations and later wandered a spirit paradise with white hounds.

feats.scene: Tastitis hurls a boulder through a log stockade and scatters the raiders behind it.
Tastitis shrugs off a fall into a stone pit with no wound.
Tastitis outruns a galloping deer across a river valley.

reply.summary: Tonumva is a white-haired city policeman with a long memory for faces and patience for paperwork. Calm under pressure, this investigator asks few questions but remembers every answer.

feats.scene: Tonumva slams a door shut on a fleeing witness and pins his coat.
Tonumva takes a shove down a short stairwell and recovers his notebook.

reply.summary: Aulrisor is a wartime killer who stole a lethal sleeping vapour to sell to armies and returned decades later alive. Silent and sly, this thief of secrets keeps a spare mask and a gas gun close.

feats.scene: Aulrisor fires a gas canister that fills a ballroom with lethal vapour in a matter of seconds.
Aulrisor survives a knife fight on a rooftop with only a gashed sleeve.

reply.summary: Llullu is an extremist agent who flattens his body like a sheet and folds himself into blades, darts and gliders. Slipping through gaps no man should fit, this saboteur can shrink small enough to hide inside a person.

feats.scene: Llullu folds an arm into a razor edge and slices a steel shutter in two.
Llullu is squeezed flat beneath a rolling door and unfolds unharmed.

reply.summary: Ontaneon is a small-time hoodlum who survived a deadly plague and decided he could never die. Crazed by the thought, this survivor ended his life proving his foolish theory with a blade.

feats.scene: Ontaneon swings a stool at a rival smuggler in a dockside tavern.
Ontaneon walks through a ward of infected strangers and never takes ill.

reply.summary: Aunceriu is a scavenger-warrior from a lofty colony world who joins a team of defenders. Small beside the gods, this insectoid fighter backs allies with swift scuttling attacks and a god's endurance.

feats.scene: Aunceriu smashes through a bulkhead in a charge that dents a steel hull.
Aunceriu takes a falling girder across the back and keeps fighting.

reply.summary: Inloncel is a swarm leader who raided market stalls for winter food and later joined gods against a tyrant. Ageless and nimble, this hive chief ended up rebuilding a ruined metropolis alongside his former rivals.

feats.scene: Inloncel rallies his swarm to topple a grocery truck and carry its cargo underground.
Inloncel stands unscathed in a collapsing grotto as the ceiling comes down.

reply.summary: Sttor is a red-skinned, yellow-eyed warrior of a vanished colony who tried to keep his comrades alive in a tyrant's prison. Strong and quick but outmatched, this small hero was crushed in an instant by a titan.

feats.scene: Sttor vaults a prison wall in a single bound and lands on a guard's shield.
Sttor withstands a hail of blows from jailers before collapsing.
Sttor sprints across a smoking courtyard faster than a charging beast.

reply.summary: Luolu is a foundling raised by insect-folk who learned late that his birth was divine. Despised at first by arrogant gods, this adventurer gave his life to stop a living equation and later awoke in a nightmare basement.

feats.scene: Luolu spends everything he has to unmake a monstrous equation before it can devour a world.
Luolu is hurled through a stone tower by a god-sized brute and rises again.

reply.summary: Eoncorser is a boy from the ice-age whose cave family was bathed in light from a fallen star, waking their minds and ending their mortality. Neutral and endlessly patient, this ancient child can share slivers of undying life with others.

feats.scene: Eoncorser leaps from a cliff and tackles a charging bison to the ground.
Eoncorser is buried beneath a landslide and walks out again after a long wait.

reply.summary: Metelliu is a masked English eccentric who prowls rooftops and tea-houses with cutlery as his calling card. Little is known beyond the mask and a theatrical streak, but this vigilante favours cunning and a mean sidestep.

feats.scene: Metelliu throws a heavy fork and pins a fleeing thief's sleeve to a door.
Metelliu drops from a ledge onto a market awning and bounces to his feet.

reply.summary: Sarorinau is a sprinting hero in a lightning emblem who fights for a bright team in a parallel city. Cheerful and fleet, this runner is a tribute to speed-obsessed champions from other stories.

feats.scene: Sarorinau runs through a wall of crates at full tilt and scatters them across the street.
Sarorinau races a crackling storm front across the avenue and arrives first.

reply.summary: Torval is a yellow-skinned youth who can turn into a steel stronghold and shield friends within. Rejected by a heroic club, this protector lost his memory while shielding them and became their first headquarters.

feats.scene: Torval swells into a wall of metal and crushes a gun emplacement against a cliff.
Torval absorbs a grenade blast from inside his hull-like body and keeps his shape.

reply.summary: Orilonni is a hot-tempered strongman raised in a harsh outback who joined a global strike team and secretly betrayed it. Arrogant and ambitious, this double agent lost a bid for command and turned traitor.

feats.scene: Orilonni hurls a jeep across a dusty compound in a fit of rage.
Orilonni is thrown through a pillar and rises swinging.

reply.summary: Teiar is a masked villain from a coming age who commands floating robotic pyramids. Purple-skinned and white-eyed, this threat from the future sends laser drones against a young team of heroes.

feats.scene: Teiar sweeps a flight of laser drones across a parking lot and melts a dozen cars.
Teiar crashes into a billboard and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Natum is a cardsharp-themed enforcer in a gang of costumed thieves, wearing a spade mark on his coat. Brash and expendable, this crook is the fourth piece in a stacked deck and the first to fall.

feats.scene: Natum snaps a heavy card-shaped blade through a vault door lock.
Natum is thrown across a casino floor and bounces off a table.

reply.summary: Anamoson is a bespectacled soldier in a front-line squad who happens to be one of its steadiest shots. Mocked for his glasses, this rifleman repaid his teasing with accuracy.

feats.scene: Anamoson takes out a distant machine-gun nest with three careful rifle shots.
Anamoson dives into a muddy trench as shells burst overhead.

reply.summary: Niaamrni is a hen grown to monstrous size by reckless feed experiments. Cranky and powerful, this barnyard terror pecks through fences and flattens farm equipment.

feats.scene: Niaamrni rams a barn door and snaps the beam holding it.
Niaamrni shrugs off a collision with a tractor.

reply.summary: Tertirllu is a red-haired chemistry student and ringleader of a trio who altered a bat-making formula to remake a whole campus. Clever but resentful, this scholar became a clawed hybrid creature after a soaking in the vat.

feats.scene: Tertirllu swipes a clawed paw through a lecture hall door and splinters it.
Tertirllu shrugs off a hard tumble down a concrete staircase.

reply.summary: Rnutento is an infant cosmos who lives disguised as a family's pet dog, brown-furred and playful. Treated as a pet, this baby supergod hides power greater than the oldest guardians can describe.

feats.scene: Rnutento yawns in a sunny garden and ripples every clock in a star cluster.
Rnutento naps unharmed as a swarm of hostile angels tries to erase the sleeping puppy.

reply.summary: Irnval is a cat-shaped mental parasite that clings to a sick girl and feeds on her feelings. Invisible to all but hosts, this fiend breathes heat, brainwashes with her milk and dies if nobody believes in her.

feats.scene: Irnval spits a ball of heat that chars a wooden barn wall.
Irnval is smashed by a thrown bench and re-forms from a child's gaze.

reply.summary: Sansarto is a blonde student with magnetic talent and a scattered past. Haunted by lost memories, this young woman once fought an old friend before peace was made.

feats.scene: Sansarto pulls a rack of steel pipes across a garage in a single sweep.
Sansarto is knocked to the floor by a swift opponent and recovers with a gasp.

reply.summary: Sevornal is a disciplined swordswoman who walks with a cane after childhood illness. Well versed in drill and duelling, this soldier proves her limp is no real handicap.

feats.scene: Sevornal cuts a hanging lantern chain with one swing of a blade.
Sevornal takes a shoulder charge and keeps her balance on one leg.

reply.summary: Neltiro is a farm-town woman with a past romance that ended without drama. Married and settled, she lives an ordinary life well away from battlefields.

feats.scene: Neltiro slaps a counter in a diner to make a point.
Neltiro shakes off a tumble on a porch step.

reply.summary: Nausar is a showy criminal who flips and vaults between rooftops and shoots with a magical bow. Quick and vain, this thief leaves bright arrows stuck in cornices as a signature.

feats.scene: Nausar looses an enchanted arrow that bursts a jeweller's display case.
Nausar lands from a high flip on a tiled roof and slides unharmed.

reply.summary: Virina is a bald, paralysed official who lost his family in a world-shaking catastrophe and now serves in a secret agency. Cold and loyal, this officer once fought in a short war and still carries its ideals.

feats.scene: Virina fires a pistol from his chair and clips a fleeing courier's briefcase.
Virina survives a grenade burst near his command post.

reply.summary: Vasnenosa is a cheerful high-school student and loyal friend with a taste for mechanics. Small in the larger world, this teenager is always first to lend a hand.

feats.scene: Vasnenosa swings a wrench at a seized bolt and frees it.
Vasnenosa takes a tumble off a bicycle and brushes off the gravel.

reply.summary: Telamani is a white-haired street vendor who sells papers and coffee near a busy tower. Warm and talkative, this shopkeeper hands out free news when somebody needs cheering up.

feats.scene: Telamani heaves a bundle of papers onto a stand.
Telamani stays on his feet when a crowd jostles his cart.

reply.summary: Riavale is a night guard patrolling a hospital for the troubled, always one corridor from the worst cell. Dutiful and unnoticed, this watchman never sees the attacker who ends his shift.

feats.scene: Riavale swings a baton against a locked cell door to scare a prisoner back.
Riavale is slammed against a brick wall and still hits the alarm.

reply.summary: Tasorse is a cab driver and former bookie who has been the steady friend of an occultist since youth. Married and hard-bitten, this driver has survived family curses and monstrous passengers with a spanner and good humour.

feats.scene: Tasorse swings a tyre iron at a lunging demon-ridden thug.
Tasorse takes a thrown chair in the chest and keeps the engine running.

reply.summary: Autauin is a member of a corrupt elite who throws jets of white-hot plasma from his palms. Self-assured and cruel, this thug torches cars and doors when negotiating gets dull.

feats.scene: Autauin melts a gate and the wall beside it with a roaring blast from both palms.
Autauin walks away from a collapsing scaffold with a scorched coat.

reply.summary: Stotau is a gang boss who builds his crimes around wheels, from getaway cars to rolling traps. Well armed and organized, this leader runs drivers like clockwork until a vigilante breaks his circle.

feats.scene: Stotau orders his gang to roll an iron cart through a shop front.
Stotau is tossed against a wheel rim and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Rntiu is a wealthy shopkeeper who owns a chain of tacky nightclubs across the country. Pompous and plump with cash, this tycoon was once briefly wed to a notorious jester.

feats.scene: Rntiu slaps a contract onto a desk with a flourish.
Rntiu sits through a barstool brawl and keeps his drink.
